specs.title: Hermes extension boundary
specs.contract: Signal Scout runtime code is confined to the self-contained plugins/signal-scout directory. It registers one model tool, one operator CLI command, three lifecycle hooks, and one explicit plugin skill through PluginContext. Installing, disabling, or removing Signal Scout requires no Signal Scout-specific change to a Hermes core file.

specs.title: Native bootstrap status
specs.contract: Enabling the native Signal Scout plugin exposes only its status capability to the bootstrap model. Native Hermes discovery and dispatch return the manifest version and explicit status-ready, research-not-implemented, research-security-not-implemented readiness. Unknown actions or fields return an error, and disabling the plugin makes the tool unavailable. This limited contract does not complete SS-001.

specs.title: Isolated Docker bootstrap
specs.contract: Exactly four Compose services remain: scout, browser, firewall and proxy. Bounded non-root Scout container has read-only root, no capabilities, no host mounts or published ports, and dedicated auth/log storage. Hermes has its own network namespace with direct outbound and DNS connectivity, no Scout-specific firewall or proxy environment configuration, and no Scout-enforced host/LAN isolation. Chromium runs in separate disposable browser container with no Hermes runtime or credential/persistent mounts, owned by trusted host lifecycle. Browser shares only firewall's network namespace; proxy has its own. Browser firewall permits proxy/replies, Hermes-to-browser private relay, and narrow browser-local launcher/relay-to-Chromium CDP control only. Browser direct/bypass IPv4/IPv6, host/LAN and DNS traffic fail. Proxy admits only configured browser source address and public HTTP:80 or opaque HTTPS CONNECT:443, rejecting Hermes/other clients, private destinations, unsupported schemes, embedded credentials, DNS failures and other ports. TLS remains verified end-to-end without decryption. SS-019 owns redirects/rebinding/background behavior; SS-S002 owns control isolation; SS-S004/S005 own container/lifetime boundary. No mission/research security completion.

specs.title: Image-owned operating settings
specs.contract: Shared image-owned docker/signal-scout/config.yaml owns Hermes/browser/proxy/logging settings plus network topology and lifecycle bounds. Defaults: INFO, 5 MiB/file, three backups, browser command30s, proxy DNS/connect/idle5/10/60s, browser startup20s, local-control connect2s, shutdown5s and deterministic smoke120s. Required scout_reviewer section supplies gpt-6-luna/none/180-second per-attempt timeout/one retry initially; SS-R003 owns native reviewer propagation. These bounds are consumed, not supervisor retries or future mission budgets; bootstrap model/low reasoning remain unchanged. Trusted host validates Compose topology and running helper/browser settings match configuration. Native Compose includes keep resources in per-service YAML: browser2,000,000,000-byte RAM/equal memory+swap/no CPU quota/PID512/bounded tmpfs, Hermes1g/1CPU, helpers256m/.5CPU. Supplied settings validate with sanitized failures; unknown switches, invalid types/ranges, missing reviewer values, real-profile/cloud/arbitrary-CDP overrides or sandbox/TLS/network relaxation fail. Apply by edit/rebuild/recreate; no hot reload/config generator/protection-disable switch.

specs.title: Subscription model status conversation
specs.contract: After separate user-completed OAuth login stored only in the dedicated Scout volume, native Hermes openai-codex runs one bounded real gpt-5.6-luna conversation with low reasoning. The model calls status exactly once, receives the actual native result, and completes an explanation. Missing auth or unavailable model fails without substituting provider, model, or billing route.
